description.narrative: The program will support the government's key reform priorities aimed at achieving higher and pro-poor economic growth that is sustainable over the medium term. The reform priorities include efforts to improve the investment climate, strengthen public financial management, and governance, and enhance poverty reduction and access to public service delivery.

description.narrative: Improved overall economic management anchored on good governance
Increased percentage of capital expenditures disbursed in the first half of the year (from 20% in the first half of 2010 to 30% in 2011) Data Source: MOF Actual value:
Increased investment to GDP ratio (from 23.4% in 2009 to 25% in 2011) Data Source: BPS Actual value:
Increased percentage of public expenditure allocated to social assistance programs (from 3.8% in 2009 to 4.0% in 2011) Data Source: MOF Actual value:
Increase in the value of net foreign direct investment inflows (from $4.9 billion in 2009 to $10 billion in 2011) Data Source: BI and BPS Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Improved public financial management and governance Indicator: Improved public procurement: Increase in the percentage of Government agencies following the revised Presidential decree (Perpes 54/2010) on procurement (0 in 2010 and 100% in 2011) Data Source: LKPP Actual value:

Output: Improved public financial management and governance Indicator: Improved results orientation of the budget process: Increase in PI 12 score as the new medium-term expenditure framework and performance-based budgeting prepared in 2010 for 2011 budget (from 1.5 in 2007) Data Source: PEFA report

Output: Improved public financial management and governance Indicator: Improved cash management and streamlined budget execution within the central Government: Increase in PEFA PI 16 score on predictability in the availability of funds for commitment of expenditure (from 1.7 in 2007) and Increase in PEFA PI 17 score on recording and management of cash balances, debt, and guarantees (from 1.7 in 2007) Data Source: PEFA report

Output: Enhanced poverty alleviation and access to public services Indicator: Improved accountability in community-based poverty reduction programs (PNPM): Reduced number of fraudulent cases (146 in 2009 to 90 in 2011) Data Source: VP Office Actual value:

Output: Improved public financial management and governance Indicator: Improved Government accounting and audit functions: Reduced number of line ministries receiving qualified opinions on their financial statements (20 in 2009 to 18 in 2011) Data Source: BPK Report Actual value:

Output: improved investment climate Indicator: Improved tax administration and reduced tax burden: Reduced time to prepare and pay for taxes (266 hours in 2010 to 240 in 2011) Data Source: Doing Business Survey Actual value:

Output: Enhanced poverty alleviation and access to public services Indicator: Improved governance and accountability in the Government's poverty programs: Increase proportion of female head households that received social assistance program (57% in 2009 to 60% in 2011) Data Source: VP Office and Coordinating Ministry of People's Welfare Actual value:
Output: improved investment climate Indicator: Improved investment regulations: Reduced time to start business (60 days in 2010 to 47 days in 2011) Data Source: Doing Business Survey Actual value:
